messages:
jamal: T-45 until change window starts. Quick go/no-go sweep — please ack and call out any blockers. Checklist: 1) smoke on preprod, 2) canary health, 3) migrations cleared, 4) rollback pin ready, 5) release notes published. ping owners.
elaine: smoke on preprod ✅ all checks green (latency and token QOS look fine). no DB migration in this release. :thumbsup:
tom: canary at 10% for 20m, error rate steady at 0.06%. memory/latency within target. raising no blockers.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued by elaine. Canary rollout plan: 10% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with 10m observation windows. Auto-rollback triggers: 3xx/5xx spike >0.5% OR latency p95 > 1000ms for 2 windows.
oncall-sre: noted thresholds. I can be on standby for immediate rollback. rollback pin: branch tag `release/2026-03-22` will be the emergency revert target.
sara: release notes pushed to the docs site: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/2026-03-22 — summary + upgrade notes included. product owners aware.
jamal: locking freeze now — no non-critical PR merges until post-rollout. If you need an exemption DM me and @oncall-sre.
elaine: started first step of canary now. will report back at each ramp.
jamal: reminder: if you need to pin a specific model or quantization profile during the window, call it out here now.
elaine: pin request: pin model `redwood-v2-q4_8` for route /chat-stream due to perf variance in experiment. approved?
ton: approved — agree we should pin for the window. Adding config: ```
PATCH /routes/chat-stream
{
  "model": "redwood-v2-q4_8",
  "pin": "release/2026-03-22"
}
```
oncall-sre: rollback command ready. shorthand: `./ops rollback --tag release/2026-03-22 --force` — I'll run if deploy-bot triggers or we manually escalate.
jamal: perfect. final check: public infra region failover on standby (eu-west1). If we see region-level issues we'll flip routing to eu-west1 and pause further ramps.
devops-bot: Canary step 1 -> step 2 scheduled in 10m. Observability monitors: alerts@pager on.
tom: stepping to 25% now, metric spike not observed.
elaine: 50% ramp in progress. no regressions so far.
jamal: go for full rollout in 20m if no alerts. otherwise hold and investigate. :rocket:
